doctor_cli_description: Checks, without contacting SofaScore, that everything the app needs is in place: Python, packages, the bridge browser, the browser profile, data and config folders, the web UI build and .env. Exit code 0: no failure; 1: at least one check failed.
doctor_cli_json: print the result as JSON instead of text
doctor_cli_live: also make ONE real request to SofaScore through the browser bridge (never done otherwise)
doctor_cli_lang: output language (default: APP_LANGUAGE, otherwise the system language, otherwise English)
ssc_description: Command line of the SofaScore data platform, for servers and automation: fetches, stores and exports match data ({sports}). It never asks questions; the result goes to stdout, logs and errors go to stderr, and the exit code tells what happened.
ssc_epilog:
Examples:
  %(prog)s sync
  %(prog)s sync --tournament 17 --dry-run
  %(prog)s export --out matches.csv
  %(prog)s status --json
  %(prog)s doctor --json

Exit codes: 0 success, 1 general error, 2 usage or configuration error, 3 partial success, 4 SofaScore is blocking, 5 storage error, 6 another instance is running, 130/143 cancelled by Ctrl+C / SIGTERM.
The web app is still started with python main.py --web.
ssc_global_options_title: global options (before or after the command)
ssc_help_help: show this help message and exit
ssc_help_config: config file (default: the SOFASCORE_CONFIG variable, then sofascore.toml in the project folder, then in the config folder)
ssc_help_data_dir: data folder for this run (default: the configured one)
ssc_help_json: print the result as one JSON document on stdout (same as --output json)
ssc_help_output: output format: text (default, in your language), json (one document) or ndjson (one object per line)
ssc_help_quiet: log errors only and print no informational lines
ssc_help_log_level: log level for this run: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR or CRITICAL
ssc_help_no_color: no colours in the log lines
ssc_help_lang: language of the text output: en or tr (default: APP_LANGUAGE, otherwise the system language, otherwise English); JSON output is never translated
ssc_help_rate: request budget for this run, in requests per second; 0 or off removes the limit (riskier: SofaScore may block you)
ssc_help_ignore_breaker: do not stop a job when SofaScore keeps refusing requests (turns the circuit breaker off)
ssc_help_cmd_version: print the version and the schema versions
ssc_help_cmd_doctor: check the environment: Python, packages, browser, folders, web UI build, .env, request budget (exit code 1 if a check fails)
ssc_help_cmd_describe: describe the sports, slices, commands, schemas, config file, error codes and exit codes for programs (always JSON)
ssc_help_cmd_config: show, check or start the configuration
ssc_help_cmd_config_show: print every setting with its value and where it comes from (secrets masked)
ssc_help_cmd_config_validate: check the config file and the environment without running anything (exit code 2 if they are not valid)
ssc_help_cmd_config_init: print a starter sofascore.toml on stdout; the file is never written for you
ssc_help_cmd_config_path: print the path of the config file in use
ssc_help_cmd_diagnostics: write the diagnostics bundle (zip: versions, settings with secrets masked, last job, log tail)
ssc_help_config_init_from_legacy: write today's settings instead of the defaults: the values of .env and of the environment, and one [[follow]] per league of config/leagues.txt
ssc_help_diagnostics_out: file or folder to write to (default: the log folder)
ssc_help_cmd_events: print the events of the event log as JSON lines: live changes, jobs and system notices (reads the log; no service has to be running)
ssc_help_events_stream: only this stream: live, change, job or system (may be repeated; default: all of them)
ssc_help_events_after: start after this sequence number (default: the beginning of the log; with --follow: now)
ssc_help_events_follow: keep running and print new events as they are written (stop with Ctrl+C)
ssc_help_events_type: only this event type; shell patterns are allowed, for example 'live.*' (may be repeated)
ssc_help_events_event: only the events of this match id (may be repeated)
ssc_help_cmd_watch: watch live matches and write their changes to the event log and to the configured sinks (runs in the foreground until stopped)
ssc_help_watch_sport: only this sport (may be repeated); with --event or --tournament: the sport of those ids
ssc_help_watch_event: watch this match id instead of the followed ones (may be repeated; needs --sport)
ssc_help_watch_tournament: watch the live matches of this tournament id instead of the followed ones (may be repeated; needs --sport)
ssc_help_watch_source: live source: page (default), direct or poll. page keeps one browser page per watched sport open (about 1.8 to 2.6 GB of memory each) and listens to its push connection, so events arrive about a second after the change; polling stays the fallback. poll only polls and starts no browser. direct connects a light client to the push server itself (about 0.2 GB of memory), with the credential read from the page's own connection and kept in memory only; polling stays its fallback. direct is never chosen for you: it uses SofaScore's own client credential outside the site's client, may break without notice when the credential or the server changes, may get your IP address blocked, and is a terms-of-use grey area that you choose knowingly
ssc_help_watch_stdout: also print every new event to stdout as one JSON line
ssc_watch_summary: Live watching stopped: {rounds} round(s), {requests} request(s), {events} new event(s), {confirmed} finished match(es) stored.
ssc_help_cmd_serve: run the HTTP API and the web app (runs in the foreground until stopped; live watching is the watch command)
ssc_help_serve_host: address to listen on (default: [server] host, 127.0.0.1 = this computer only). Any other address opens the app to your network: set an access token (SOFASCORE_API_TOKEN); 0.0.0.0 also needs the allowed host names
ssc_help_serve_allowed_hosts: comma-separated host names and addresses the server answers to, used as written (default: [server] allowed_hosts or SOFASCORE_ALLOWED_HOSTS; without them: the loopback names, plus the address given with --host)
ssc_help_serve_allow_any_host: with --host 0.0.0.0 and no allowed host names: answer to any host name. Insecure: it turns off the protection against DNS rebinding. Ignored when allowed host names are set
ssc_help_serve_dev: restart the server when the code changes (development)
ssc_help_serve_scheduler: run the in-app scheduler: the [[schedule.task]] entries of the config file start jobs at their times (default: [schedule] enabled, off)
ssc_help_serve_no_scheduler: do not run the in-app scheduler, even when [schedule] enabled is set
ssc_serve_scheduler: Scheduler on: {count} task(s); their next runs are in the web app's Health page and /api/v1/status.
ssc_serve_sinks: Delivering events to {count} configured sink(s) while the server runs.
ssc_serve_failed: The web server could not start or stopped with an error (code {code}); see the log lines above (is the port already in use?).
ssc_serve_hosts_required:
The web server was asked to listen on every network interface ({host}), but it was not told which host names it may answer to.
List the names or IP addresses you open the app with, for example:
  {prog} serve --host {host} --allowed-hosts localhost,127.0.0.1,my-server.lan
or set [server] allowed_hosts in the config file, or SOFASCORE_ALLOWED_HOSTS in .env or the environment.
Or pass --allow-any-host to answer to any name. That is insecure: it turns off the protection against DNS rebinding.
ssc_serve_exposed_without_token: WARNING: the web app is listening on {host}:{port} without an access token. Anyone who can reach this port can read and delete your data and change the settings. Set SOFASCORE_API_TOKEN, or keep the port behind a firewall or a reverse proxy you control.

ssc_help_cmd_backup: create, list, check and restore backups of the data folder
ssc_help_cmd_backup_create: write a backup to the backups folder of the data folder (format 2: state, data and settings)
ssc_help_cmd_backup_list: list the backups in the backups folder, newest first
ssc_help_cmd_backup_verify: read a backup and check it (exit code 1 if it has problems)
ssc_help_cmd_backup_restore: restore a backup from the backups folder into the data folder (also backups of version 2.x)
ssc_help_backup_scope: what goes in: all (default), state (follows, job history, event log), data (match files and change log), config (settings files only), or one old folder: seasons, matches, match_details
ssc_help_backup_include_secrets: also put the .env file in the backup (it can hold the proxy password and tokens; the file name then says _with_env and only you can read it)
ssc_help_backup_name: the file name of the backup in the backups folder (see: backup list)
ssc_help_backup_force: the data folder is not empty: move its data to the trash first and replace it (a restore never merges)
ssc_help_backup_dry_run: only say what would happen; change nothing
ssc_backup_skipped: Not restored (settings files are outside the data folder; copy them back by hand if you need them): {members}
ssc_backup_restore_occupied: The data folder is not empty ({entries}): the restore needs --force, which moves this data to the trash first.
ssc_help_cmd_migrate: convert the data stored in the old layout (2.x folders) to the new layout (v3); verifies every copy and keeps the old files unless --delete-legacy is given
ssc_help_migrate_dry_run: show what would be converted, the sizes before and after and what cannot be converted; changes nothing
ssc_help_migrate_exact: with --dry-run: compute the new size from every match instead of a sample (slower)
ssc_help_migrate_tournament: only this tournament (unique tournament id; repeat for several); the change log and processed/ are left for a run without this option
ssc_help_migrate_limit: stop after N matches; run the command again to continue
ssc_help_migrate_delete_legacy: also delete every old copy whose new copy was verified again (match folders, schedule files, season lists, score_changes.jsonl); needs --yes
ssc_help_migrate_purge_derived: delete derived files: season summaries of seasons that have schedules, and the CSV exports under match_details/processed/; needs --yes
ssc_migrate_plan: Dry run, nothing was changed. To convert: {events} matches, {pages} schedule pages in {seasons} seasons, {lists} season lists; change log: {change_log}.
ssc_migrate_plan_delete: Old match copies to delete after verification: {copies}.
ssc_migrate_plan_size: Size: {before} now in the old layout, about {after} in the new layout ({how}).
ssc_migrate_plan_limited: --limit stops the run after {limit} matches; schedules, season lists and the change log follow in a later run.
ssc_migrate_done: Converted: {events} matches ({existing} more were already in the new layout), {pages} schedule pages, {lists} season lists; change log: {change_log}.
ssc_migrate_deleted: Old copies deleted: {events} match folders, {pages} schedule files, {lists} season-list files; score_changes.jsonl: {change_log}.
ssc_migrate_size: Size: {before} in the old layout, {after} in the new layout ({seconds} s).
ssc_migrate_stopped: Stopped before the end; run the command again to continue.
ssc_migrate_failed: Not converted, the old copy is kept
ssc_migrate_conflicts: New copies that differ from the old one and are not newer (nothing was overwritten)
ssc_migrate_unconvertible: Cannot be converted, stays in place and stays readable
ssc_migrate_log_conflict: the copy differs from score_changes.jsonl, nothing was written
ssc_list_more: ... and {count} more (--json lists all of them)
ssc_help_cmd_catalog: rebuild, check or reconcile the catalog (the index of the stored files, .meta/catalog.db)
ssc_help_cmd_catalog_rebuild: rebuild the catalog from the stored files (refused while another process uses the data folder)
ssc_help_cmd_catalog_verify: compare the catalog with the stored files; exit code 1 when an inconsistency is left
ssc_help_cmd_catalog_reconcile: re-index the files that changed behind the catalog (looks at every match folder)
ssc_help_catalog_mode: auto: in place when the schema fits, else recreate the file
ssc_help_catalog_verify_deep: read every match and every payload of the new layout again
ssc_help_catalog_repair: re-index what does not match from the files (refused while another process uses the data folder)
ssc_help_catalog_reconcile_deep: ignore the signatures: read everything again, then verify and repair (refused while another process uses the data folder)
ssc_catalog_rebuilt: Catalog rebuilt ({mode}): {events} matches ({v3} in the new layout, {legacy} in the old one), {slices} slices, {seconds} s.
ssc_catalog_rebuild_incomplete: The rebuild did not finish; the previous catalog is kept.
ssc_catalog_inconsistent: {count} inconsistencies are left (catalog verify --repair, or catalog rebuild).
ssc_catalog_reconciled: Catalog reconciled: {checked} matches checked, {indexed} re-indexed, {removed} removed, {pending} unfinished writes, {seasons} season listings, {seconds} s.
ssc_help_log_format: format of the log lines on stderr: text or json (one JSON object per line)
ssc_help_wait: when another process holds the data folder, wait up to this many seconds instead of exiting with 6
ssc_help_progress: write the progress of a job to stderr: none (default), text, or ndjson (one job event per line)
ssc_help_cmd_sync: bring every configured league up to date: season lists, schedules, then the matches that need details
ssc_help_sync_tournament: only this tournament (SofaScore unique-tournament id); it need not be configured
ssc_help_sync_only: events: fetch only the match details of the schedules already stored (no season lists, no schedules)
ssc_help_sync_recheck: first reopen the "slice not available" markers (legacy: only unconfirmed ones; all: every marker), then download
ssc_help_refresh_include_legacy: also refresh, once, old records that have no observation (by default they count as final)
ssc_help_dry_run: send no request and change nothing: show what would be fetched and how many requests that takes at least
ssc_help_cmd_fetch: fetch explicit targets that need not be configured
ssc_help_cmd_fetch_event: fetch the details of these matches
ssc_help_cmd_fetch_tournament: fetch a tournament: its season list, schedules and match details
ssc_help_fetch_season: only this season (repeatable); default: every season of the season list
ssc_help_cmd_refresh: re-read provisional records only: the /event of matches inside the refresh window
ssc_help_refresh_tournament: only the matches of this tournament
ssc_cancel_requested: Stopping after the current step (the job is cancelled; press Ctrl+C again to exit at once).
ssc_job_cancelled: Cancelled: job {job_id} stopped after its current step; what was fetched is stored.
ssc_sync_summary: Download finished. Matches that needed details: {total} ({ok} fetched, {failed} failed). Provisional records refreshed: {refreshed} ({changed} changed).
ssc_sync_empty_schedules: No match list for {count} season(s): the list came back empty.
ssc_sync_failed_listings: {count} season list(s) or schedule(s) could not be fetched; the job is partial (details in --json).
ssc_plan_listings: Lists to fetch: {season_lists} season list(s), {schedules} schedule(s); {fresh} are fresh and skipped.
ssc_plan_events: Matches that need requests: {full} without a record, {refill} with missing slices, {refresh} to refresh.
ssc_plan_requests_minimum: Requests: at least {requests} (the round pages of a schedule and the matches of new lists are not known before they are fetched).
ssc_progress_breaker: Too many failed requests ({reason}); the job stops sending requests.
ssc_help_cmd_data: destructive maintenance of the data folder
ssc_help_cmd_data_clear: delete stored data; every copy goes, in the old folders and in the new layout (v3/); follows, settings and job history stay
ssc_help_data_clear_scope: what to delete: events (match details), schedules (match lists), seasons (season lists) or all
ssc_help_data_clear_all: delete match details, match lists and season lists (same as --scope all)
ssc_help_data_yes: confirm the deletion (without it nothing is deleted)
ssc_data_cleared: Cleared {scope}: {cleared}. The catalog was rebuilt from the remaining files.
ssc_help_cmd_data_recheck: reopen the "slice not available" markers so that the next download asks for those slices again (sends no request)
ssc_help_data_recheck_all: every marker, also the ones confirmed by a definitive answer (default: only unconfirmed markers of older versions)
ssc_help_data_recheck_tournament: only the matches of this tournament
ssc_help_cmd_export: write the stored data as a file: a dataset of the normalized schema (events, slices, changes), the raw payloads or the 2.x wide CSV (legacy-wide-csv)
ssc_help_export_profile: CSV profile: legacy-wide-csv, 2.x's wide CSV with one row per match (the default when neither --dataset nor --schema is given)
ssc_help_export_schema: normalized: the records of data schema v1; raw: the stored SofaScore payloads as they are
ssc_help_export_format: normalized: jsonl (default; one record per line), csv, parquet (needs pyarrow) or sqlite; raw: jsonl (one line per payload) or tree (one folder per match); the profile: csv
ssc_help_export_out: where to write; - is stdout (jsonl and csv only). Default for the wide CSV: match_details/processed/all_matches_<time>.csv in the data folder; for a dataset: exports/<dataset>_<time>.<format> in the data folder
ssc_help_export_tournament: only the matches of this tournament (repeatable)
ssc_help_export_force: replace an existing target (datasets and --schema raw)
ssc_help_export_dataset: events, slices or changes (normalized); with --schema raw: events (the event payload only) or slices (every payload, the default)
ssc_help_export_sport: only the matches of this sport (slug, for example football)
ssc_help_export_season: only the matches of this season (repeatable; not for changes)
ssc_help_export_status: only the matches in this status class (repeatable; not for changes)
ssc_help_export_from: only from this time on: ISO 8601 date or date-time, UTC (the start of the match; for changes the time the change was recorded)
ssc_help_export_to: only up to this time, as --from; a date includes the whole day
ssc_export_dataset_streamed: Export written to stdout: {rows} records of {dataset}
ssc_help_cmd_follows: what the application follows: tournaments, teams, players, matches
ssc_help_cmd_follows_add: add a follow (the live service watches the ones with --live)
ssc_help_cmd_follows_remove: remove a follow (a follow of the config file is changed there)
ssc_help_cmd_follows_export: print every follow as [[follow]] tables of the config file
ssc_help_follows_seasons: all, current, last:N or comma-separated season ids
ssc_follows_not_found: {kind} {id} is not followed; nothing to remove.
ssc_help_cmd_jobs: job history and control, across processes
ssc_help_cmd_jobs_cancel: ask a running job to stop, whichever process runs it
ssc_help_cmd_jobs_tail: print the events of a job, one JSON object per line
ssc_help_jobs_follow: keep printing new events until the job ends (Ctrl+C stops)
ssc_help_jobs_after: only events after this sequence number
ssc_jobs_cancel_requested: Cancel requested for job {id}; the process that runs it stops within a second.
ssc_jobs_not_running: Job {id} is not running ({state}); nothing to cancel.
ssc_help_cmd_status: data summary, health, locks, the running and the last job, the live service
ssc_help_status_check: print nothing; exit code 0 when the data folder is healthy, 1 when it is not
ssc_help_status_coverage: also show matches and details per tournament
ssc_status_no_store: Data folder: {path} (empty: nothing was downloaded yet)
ssc_status_store: Store: layout {layout}, state schema {state}, catalog schema {catalog}; healthy
ssc_status_unhealthy: Store: the catalog must be rebuilt ({reason}); run: ssc catalog rebuild
ssc_status_live: Live service: running (pid {pid}, source {source}, sports {sports}, leading {leaders})
ssc_version_store: Store: layout {layout}, catalog schema {catalog}, state schema {state}
ssc_legacy_deprecated: main.py flags are deprecated and will be removed; this run is: {commands}
cli_description: Fetches and analyses football match data from SofaScore.
cli_epilog:
Headless / CI examples (deprecated flags: each run is translated into a command of the new CLI and says which one on stderr; see python main.py <command> --help, or ssc <command> --help):
  %(prog)s --headless --update-all          (ssc sync)
  %(prog)s --refresh-only                   (ssc refresh)
  %(prog)s --headless --csv-export          (ssc export)
  %(prog)s --doctor --json                  (ssc doctor --json)
Exit codes: 0 success, 2 usage error, 3 partial, 4 SofaScore is blocking, 5 storage error, 6 the data folder is in use, 130/143 cancelled.
cli_help_help: Show this help message and exit
cli_help_headless: Fetch data in bulk without showing the user interface
cli_help_update_all: Headless update of every league (or one with --league-id); --fetch-mode sets the scope
cli_help_fetch_mode: With --update-all: full = seasons + matches + details, details = match details only (same as the web app)
cli_help_league_id: With --update-all: only this SofaScore league ID (it must be in the config)
cli_help_config: Configuration file (sofascore.toml). An old leagues file (.txt) is ignored with a warning; leagues are read from config/leagues.txt or from [[follow]]
cli_help_data_dir: Data root folder (default: DATA_DIR in .env, otherwise data)
cli_help_host: Address the web server listens on (default: 127.0.0.1, this computer only). Any other address opens the app to your network: set SOFASCORE_API_TOKEN; 0.0.0.0 also needs SOFASCORE_ALLOWED_HOSTS.
cli_help_allow_any_host: With --host 0.0.0.0: answer to any host name instead of requiring SOFASCORE_ALLOWED_HOSTS. Insecure: turns off the DNS-rebinding protection. Ignored when SOFASCORE_ALLOWED_HOSTS is set.
cli_help_dev: Restart the web server when the code changes (development)
cli_help_refresh_only: Only refresh provisional records (the /event of matches inside REFRESH_WINDOW_HOURS); for a daily cron job. One league with --league-id
cli_help_refresh_legacy: Also refresh, once, old records that have no observation.json (default: they count as final)
cli_help_recheck_unavailable: Reopen the "this slice does not exist for this match" markers for a re-check (sends no requests; the slices are requested again on the next download). legacy (default): only markers left by earlier versions that were not confirmed by a definitive answer (404 / empty response); all: every marker. One league with --league-id; given together with --headless --update-all, the markers are reopened first and the download runs after that
cli_help_watch: Live watcher (ssc watch --source poll --stdout): with --sport and --league-ids or --event-ids; events go to stdout and to the event log (ssc events)
cli_help_watch_hours: --watch: run for at most this many hours (default: until Ctrl+C, or until the matches in --event-ids have finished)
cli_help_doctor: Environment check: Python, packages, browser, folders, web UI build, .env (does not contact SofaScore; exit code 1 if a check fails). Options: --doctor --help (--json, --strict, --only, --skip, --lang, --live)
cli_help_diagnostics: Write the diagnostics bundle (zip: versions, settings with secrets masked, last job, log tail) and exit. Without PATH it is written to the log folder
cli_watch_usage: --watch needs --sport and --league-ids or --event-ids. Example: python main.py --watch --sport football --league-ids 17,8
cli_headless_usage:
--headless needs --update-all and/or --csv-export. Examples:
  python main.py --headless --update-all
  python main.py --headless --update-all --fetch-mode details --league-id 52
  python main.py --headless --csv-export --data-dir ./data
details_some_complete: {count} matches already have every detail slice; the missing or partial ones will be processed.
details_all_complete: Every match already has complete details!
details_fetching_league: Fetching match details for league ID {league_id}...
details_league_dir_missing: No match folder found for league ID {league_id}!
details_fetching_all: Fetching match details for all leagues...
details_league_ids_found: Found {count} match IDs for the league.
details_total_to_fetch: Details will be fetched for {count} matches...

Open this URL in your browser:

launcher_leave_open: Leave this window open. Close it to stop the app.

notice_menu_backup_old_layout: Note: backup and restore here copy only the old folders (seasons/, matches/, match_details/). Matches stored in the new layout (v3/) are not included; copy the whole data folder to keep them.
notice_menu_clear_both_layouts: Note: clearing seasons, matches or match details removes them from both the old folders and the new layout (v3/).
notice_menu_disk_old_layout: Note: disk sizes cover the old folders only; matches stored in the new layout (v3/) are in the counts but not in the sizes.
